result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.mutate_node_attrs_ws()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Transform a node attribute using a function on selected nodes. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L8139-L8221){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.mutate_node_attrs_ws(node_attr, func) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Applies a transformation function to the specified attribute for all selected nodes. The function receives each node's current attribute value and returns the new value. Requires an active node selection. Nodes without the specified attribute are skipped. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [node_attr]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Name of the attribute to transform. [func]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Callable]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Transformation function that takes the current attribute value and returns the new value. Called once per selected node. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#ef64ca7f .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph() graph.add_node('A', score=10) graph.add_node('B', score=20) graph.add_node('C', score=30) # Double the score for selected nodes id_a = graph.get_id_from_label('A') id_b = graph.get_id_from_label('B') id_c = graph.get_id_from_label('C') (graph .select_nodes_by_id([id_a, id_b]) .mutate_node_attrs_ws('score', lambda x: x * 2) ) # Returns 20 graph.get_node(id_a).attributes['score'] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 20 ``` ::: ::: ::: {#008dec1b .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Returns 40 graph.get_node(id_b).attributes['score'] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 40 ``` ::: ::: ::: {#b9fdc817 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Returns 30 (unchanged) graph.get_node(id_c).attributes['score'] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` 30 ``` ::: ::: Conditional transformations: ::: {#c23dbc5d .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A", price=80) .add_node(label="B", price=120) .add_node(label="C", price=150) ) # Apply discount to high-value nodes ( graph .select_nodes(lambda n: n.attributes.get('price', 0) > 100) .mutate_node_attrs_ws('price', lambda p: p * 0.9) ) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=4} ``` Number of nodes : 3 Number of edges : 0 Directed : False Density : 0.00 Average degree (min, max) : 0.00 (0, 0) Connected : False Number of connected components : 3 Tree : False Bipartite : True ``` ::: :::
